speech_verification.heard: Staff measured a growing bend, two days later the Quebec Bridge fell. On August 27, steel member 9L bent farther. Some called it critical, the superintendent saw no danger. On August 29, the unfinished bridge collapsed. The commission found the lower members were defectively designed. It did not believe the fall preventable after August 27. Yet it said better judgment might have prevented the loss of life, the bend had been measured.

notes.hook: Clear premise establishing the impending structural failure.
notes.clarity: Logical chronological flow following the warning and collapse.
notes.payoff: The commission conclusion lands somewhat flatly without emphasizing the casualty scale.
notes.visuals: Relevant archival imagery combined with a helpful structural diagram.
notes.loop: Phrasing in beat seven circles cleanly back to the opening statement.

rewrite: Beat 7: 'Yet better judgment could have saved seventy-five lives after staff measured the fatal bend.'
rounds.better_than_last: Integrates a clear technical schematic to explain the failure point effectively.
